description: This file is a Python script used for generating and postprocessing markdown documentation files from header and JSON files located within a specific project structure. It includes functions for converting headers to markdown, JSON files to markdown, postprocessing markdown files, and orchestrating these tasks via command-line arguments.

methods.name: generate_md(logfile=None)
methods.description: Main function for generating markdown files; traverses plugin directories, converts headers or JSON files to markdown based on presence.

methods.name: convert_json_to_md(plugin_path)
methods.description: Converts plugin JSON files to markdown documentation using an external script.

methods.name: convert_h_to_md(plugin_path, logfile=None)
methods.description: Converts header files in a plugin directory to markdown documentation using an external script.

methods.name: postprocess_md()
methods.description: Postprocesses generated markdown files to clean up and fix links.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point for executing the script with command-line interface, orchestrating the documentation generation process.
